step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture visualizes an ingestion and analysis pipeline for governance, risk, and compliance data. External applications stream data to Kinesis, which Fargate processes and stores into Aurora and S3. A scheduler triggers a Fargate analysis engine that launches an EMR job. EMR reads data from Aurora and S3, emitting compliance violation events to EventBridge. EventBridge forwards these to SQS, where Fargate processes notifications.

nodes.name: EMR
nodes.notes: Runs Spark analysis rules over Aurora and S3 datasets.

edges.notes: Applications push logs to Kinesis stream.
Fargate service consumes and parses stream data.
Fargate stores parsed metadata into Aurora.
Fargate persists raw and processed logs into S3.
Scheduler triggers analysis execution on Fargate.
EMR sends rule violation events to EventBridge.
EventBridge routes violation messages to SQS queue.
Fargate consumes queue messages to send alerts.
